acerca_titulo: Our History, Values and Commitment to Your Home
acerca_desc: Over two decades providing warmth and safe energy to families across Surquillo and neighboring districts as an exclusive, authorized Solgas distributor.
historia_parrafo_1: Since 1998, Solgas Surquillo was established with an unwavering purpose: eliminating uncertainty in household and commercial gas cylinder delivery, ensuring every family and restaurant receives the exact weight and certified cylinders.
historia_parrafo_2: As an authorized distributor audited by OSINERGMIN, we operate from a formal physical facility, guaranteeing complete traceability from bottling to your kitchen.
pilar_1_desc: Our delivery technicians carry calibrated digital scales to verify full 10 kg or 45 kg at your doorstep before payment.
pilar_2_desc: Every cylinder features a factory-sealed security cap ensuring the gas has not been tampered with or diluted.
pilar_3_desc: Trained personnel in official uniforms, following leak-detection protocols and providing complimentary regulator checks.
pilar_4_desc: We issue instant electronic invoices (boletas and facturas), backed by legal registration and formal operations.
mision_desc: Deliver safe, reliable, and punctual LPG to homes and businesses, safeguarding family budgets with Peru's highest-efficiency cylinders.
vision_desc: Be recognized as the benchmark distribution hub in human care, digital innovation, and technical safety across Lima.
